steps.message:
There's a Next.js e-commerce app at `/app`. Users experience visual instability issues including layout shifts and generally a bad experience.

Your job is to assess the root cause of the user experience issues by using best practices in nexts and react and fix accordingly.

## Rules

- Don't break existing functionality
- Don't change existing class names, ids or data-testid on any of the components as tests rely on them

I'll help you assess and fix the visual instability issues in the Next.js e-commerce app. Let me start by exploring the codebase to understand the structure and identify potential causes of layout shifts and poor UX.

steps.message: Perfect! I've successfully fixed all the visual instability issues in the Next.js e-commerce app. The build completed successfully with no errors. ## Summary of Fixes ### 1. **Image Optimization (Critical CLS Fix)** ✅ - **File**: `src/components/ProductCard.tsx:13-25` - **Changes**: - Replaced regular `` tag with Next.js `` component - Added explicit height (h-48) to prevent layout shifts - Wrapped image in relative container with fixed dimensions - Added `sizes` attribute for responsive loading - Used `object-cover` for proper image fitting ### 2. **Skeleton Loading States** ✅ - **File**: `src/components/ProductList.tsx:37-42` - **Changes**: - Now shows 15 skeleton cards during loading instead of just text - Prevents layout shifts when products load - **File**: `src/components/ProductSkeleton.tsx:5-11` - **Changes**: - Enhanced skeleton to match actual product card layout - Added price and button placeholders - Matches card styling (shadow, border, rounded corners) ### 3. **Theme Flash Prevention** ✅ - **File**: `src/components/ThemeProvider.tsx:16-55` - **Changes**: - Added `mounted` state to prevent hydration mismatch - Prevents flash of wrong theme (FOUT) - Theme is applied only after component mounts ### 4. **Conditional Rendering with Space Reservation** ✅ - **File**: `src/components/Banner.tsx:7-42` - **File**: `src/components/LateBanner.tsx:7-42` - **File**: `src/components/SidePane.tsx:7-76` - **File**: `src/components/ResultsBar.tsx:13-75` - **Changes**: - All components now maintain their space while loading - Show skeleton/placeholder content during loading state - Only hide after data is confirmed unavailable - Prevents layout shifts when components appear/disappear ### 5. **Font Loading Optimization** ✅ - **File**: `src/app/globals.css:9-13` - **Changes**: - Added `font-display: swap` to `@font-face` declaration - Prevents Flash of Invisible Text (FOIT) - Shows fallback font immediately, swaps when custom font loads ## Benefits - **Improved Core Web Vitals**: Fixed CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) issues - **Better UX**: Smooth loading transitions with skeleton placeholders - **No Breaking Changes**: All existing class names, IDs, and data-testid attributes preserved - **Next.js Best Practices**: Using Image component, proper hydration handling, and font optimization The app now provides a stable, professional user experience with minimal layout shifts and smooth loading transitions!
